pages.title: Burning Liquid Fuel
pages.text: A Blaze Burner normally eats solid fuel. Two mods let it burn fluids from pipes instead, which is how oil products and biofuels reach Create's heat. See [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().

pages.title: Create: Liquid Fuel
pages.text: A plain Blaze Burner takes piped fluid: lava, Seed Oil, Bioethanol, Peanut Oil, and TFMG's diesel, gasoline, kerosene, naphtha, heavy oil and napalm.

Bioethanol, Peanut Oil and TFMG's napalm superheat the burner (the blue flame). The others only heat it. Seed Oil and Bioethanol come from Crafts & Additions; Peanut Oil from Garnished. Peanut Oil burns 5,000 ticks a bucket in either burner.

pages.title: Blaze Burner with Straw
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' version. Add a Straw to a Blaze Burner and it takes fuel from buckets or pipes.
Its fuels (burn time per 1000 mB): diesel, gasoline and biodiesel 24000 ticks; lava 20000; crude oil 9600; ethanol 8000; creosote and plant oil 4800. Bioethanol (biofuel tag) is superheated.
So TFMG's diesel, gasoline, crude oil and creosote all burn here, through shared fluid tags. Crude oil and creosote need the Straw burner; TFMG's other fuels work in a plain Blaze Burner too.

pages.title: Straw
pages.text: Craft this to convert a Blaze Burner. Biofuel chain: crops to Biomass, seeds to Seed Oil, then Bioethanol. Check JEI.
Pollution: a Blaze Burner, with or without Straw, makes smog while it burns fuel. See [#](2E5AAC)[Pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#](). Solid-fuel option: Biomass Pellets.
